name: Fated
source: You're a postgrad student who's just gotten a job at the swanky Café Milan -- but things here are not quite as they seem. Team up with your chosen love interest to figure out what's really going on.
translation: 你是一名研究生，刚刚在时髦的米兰咖啡馆找到了一份工作——但这​​里的事情并不像看上去的那样。与你选择的爱人合作，弄清楚到底发生了什么。
